angle.headline: Altman Postpones South Korea Trip, Leaving Samsung Chip Talks in Limbo
angle.angle: Sam Altman's last-minute postponement of his South Korea visit disrupts high-stakes AI chip partnership discussions with Samsung Electronics.

article.title: Altman Postpones South Korea Trip, Leaving Samsung Chip Talks in Limbo
article.body:
OpenAI CEO Sam Altman has postponed a closely watched trip to South Korea that was scheduled for next week, with the AI company citing personal reasons for the delay.

The visit had centred on meetings with Samsung Electronics at its Suwon campus, where Samsung had prepared a multi-day schedule to discuss custom AI chip development. The postponement leaves the timeline for a potential chip partnership in limbo.

Naver and Kakao executives had also confirmed meetings with Altman during the planned two-day trip, with both companies exploring AI licensing agreements with OpenAI.
